name: Postman
description_en:
Postman is an API engineering platform for sending requests, organizing them into collections, writing tests, documenting interfaces and collaborating. Its current product also includes CLI and agent-oriented tools. A saved collection can become a repeatable functional test rather than a series of manually retyped requests.

The catalog category is API management, but Postman testing and collaboration should not be confused with a production gateway that proxies every consumer request. Local execution, Postman Cloud scheduling and enterprise private runners have different reachability, credential and plan requirements.
description_zh:
Postman 是 API 工程平台，用于发送请求、组织集合、编写测试、记录接口及协作，当前也包含 CLI 和面向 Agent 的工具。保存的集合可成为重复执行的功能测试，无需反复手输请求。

目录归类为 API 管理，但测试和协作不等于代理全部消费者请求的生产网关。本地执行、Postman Cloud 定时执行及企业私有 Runner 的可达性、凭据及方案要求不同。

steps.en: Create one test collection and environment with disposable API data.
steps.zh: 创建一个测试集合及环境，使用可丢弃 API 数据。

steps.en: Write business assertions and inspect error handling before repeating state-changing requests.
steps.zh: 编写业务断言，重复修改状态请求前先核查错误处理。

steps.en: Check shared secrets, reachability, files and monitoring usage before scheduling.
steps.zh: 定时运行前核对共享秘密、可达性、文件及监控用量。

items.en: Cloud schedules cannot read local-only secrets or local working-directory files.
items.zh: 云端定时运行无法读取本地专用秘密及本地工作目录文件。

items.en: Local response details have session, size and memory limits.
items.zh: 本地响应详情有会话、大小及内存限制。

items.en: Collection requests and scripts need safe test data and meaningful assertions; automatic generation is not validation.
items.zh: 集合请求与脚本需安全测试数据及有效断言，自动生成不等于验证。

sections.title_en: Turn an API workflow into explicit assertions
sections.title_zh: 将 API 流程转成明确断言
sections.en: A proposed trial could create a disposable test order, read it by the returned ID and verify the returned status. Store the service URL as an environment value, pass data with scripts, and write named post-response JavaScript tests using pm.test and pm.expect. Check the business field as well as the HTTP code. Postman can help generate test code, but an AI-generated assertion is not proof that the business contract is correct; review expected values and failure cases. This example was not executed.
sections.zh: 建议试验：创建可丢弃测试订单，用返回 ID 读取，再验证状态。以环境值存服务地址，用脚本传递数据，以 pm.test、pm.expect 编写具名响应后 JavaScript 测试；既检查 HTTP 状态，也检查业务字段。Postman 可辅助生成测试代码，但 AI 断言不能证明业务契约正确，仍需核对预期与失败情况。本例未执行。

sections.title_en: A failed assertion is different from sending the request again
sections.title_zh: 断言失败不同于重新发送请求
sections.en: Runner can order and skip requests, iterate data and stop on a script exception or send problem. Do not assume that setting automatically treats every failed assertion identically. The test guide also lets you rerun post-response scripts against the last response without resending the request. That is useful when correcting a test after POST, PUT or DELETE already changed server data. It retests the saved response rather than proving the server still behaves the same now; cleanup and safe replay remain the test author’s responsibility.
sections.zh: Runner 可排序、跳过请求和迭代数据，并在脚本异常或发送故障时停止；不能假设该设置会同样处理每种断言失败。测试指南还允许对上次响应重跑响应后脚本，无需重发请求，适用于 POST、PUT、DELETE 已修改服务器数据后修正测试。但这只重测已有响应，不能证明服务器当前仍相同，清理及安全重放仍归测试作者。

sections.title_en: Scheduling moves execution to Postman Cloud
sections.title_zh: 定时执行会转到 Postman Cloud
sections.en: Scheduled collections run in the cloud, not on the desktop. Local working-directory request files are unavailable; test data must be uploaded. Cloud execution cannot use a value backed only by Local Vault. It requires the shared value, with the secret in Shared Vault and its referencing variable shared separately. The scheduling guide says the interactive OAuth 2.0 authentication flow is unsupported; follow its token guidance rather than assuming a desktop sign-in carries across. Scheduled requests consume monitoring-call allowances.
sections.zh: 定时集合在云端执行，不在桌面。无法使用本地工作目录请求文件，测试数据需上传；也不能使用仅由 Local Vault 提供的值。云端需要共享值：秘密放 Shared Vault，引用变量还要另行共享。定时指南说明不支持 OAuth 2.0 认证交互流程，应依其 token 指引，不能假设桌面登录可直接沿用。定时请求消耗监控调用额度。

sections.title_en: Local and shared vaults solve different access problems
sections.title_zh: 本地与共享保险库解决不同访问问题
sections.en: Local Vault secrets and its key are not synced to Postman Cloud. The access guide warns that sign-out, changing apps or machines does not preserve local secrets, and the key cannot recover them; export/import is a separate operation. Shared Vault syncs secrets and is available on Solo, Team and Enterprise, while external-vault integrations need Enterprise with the Advanced Security Administration add-on. Review who can access the selected workspace before sharing test credentials. These are documented boundaries, not an independent security audit.
sections.zh: Local Vault 秘密及密钥不与 Postman Cloud 同步。访问指南警告：退出、切换应用或设备不保留本地秘密，密钥也不能恢复，需另行导入／导出。Shared Vault 同步秘密，适用于 Solo、Team、Enterprise；外部保险库集成需 Enterprise 加 Advanced Security Administration 附加项。共享测试凭据前应核对工作区访问者。这些是文档边界，不是独立安全审计。

sections.title_en: Run results are not a permanent complete traffic archive
sections.title_zh: 运行结果不是永久完整流量档案
sections.en: For local functional runs, the Runner guide says request/response details are session-local, with bodies persisted only below 300 KB; sign-out, another-device login or browser refresh removes logged details. Large runs can exhaust memory and previously persisted responses may be deleted. Run reports and detailed response bodies are therefore different artifacts. Confirm the evidence you need before a long run, and use the documented desktop report export where supported; report availability is also plan-dependent.
sections.zh: 本地功能执行中，Runner 指南说明请求／响应详情限当前会话，正文仅小于 300 KB 才保留；退出、另一设备登录或刷新浏览器会移除日志详情。大运行可能耗尽内存并删除此前响应。因此运行报告与详细响应体是不同产物。长测试前应明确所需证据，在支持时使用桌面报告导出；报告可用性也受方案约束。

sections.title_en: Seats are only one part of the bill
sections.title_zh: 席位只是账单的一部分
sections.en: The current page lists Free at $0, Solo at $9/month billed annually, Team at $19/user/month billed annually and Enterprise by quote. Free is a single-user tier; Team adds collaboration. Paid plan meters include AI credits/overages and cloud performance testing at $0.04/VuH; request automation also has monitoring allowances. Unlimited local collection/performance runs do not make cloud execution unlimited. GraphQL/gRPC collection runs and data-file iteration require a paid tier. Confirm add-ons, billing cycle, region and monitoring volume before comparing total cost.
sections.zh: 当前页面列 Free $0、Solo 按年计费月均 $9、Team 按年每用户月均 $19，Enterprise 询价。Free 为单用户层级，Team 增加协作。付费计价还含 AI 额度／超额及云性能测试每 VuH $0.04，自动请求另有监控额度。本地集合／性能测试不限不代表云端不限；GraphQL／gRPC 集合执行及数据文件迭代需付费层级。比较总成本前应核对附加项、周期、地区及监控量。

sections.title_zh: 从一个可复现集合开始
sections.en: Evaluate Postman when API developers or QA engineers need shared requests, explicit checks and automated runs. A single saved successful request is not enough to establish regression coverage, load capacity or production monitoring. Start with a disposable environment and review expected success, authorization failure, malformed input and cleanup. Source-code licenses for individual tools do not establish that the whole platform is open source; no full-platform license review or hands-on test was performed.
sections.zh: 若 API 开发或 QA 需要共享请求、明确检查及自动执行，可评估 Postman。只保存一个成功请求不足以证明回归覆盖、负载能力或生产监控。应在可丢弃环境检查成功、授权失败、错误输入及清理。单个工具源码许可不能证明完整平台开源，本次未审阅整个平台许可，也未实测。
